mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity and noradrenergic tone; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which escitalopram may inhibit to a minor degree, and combined use increases serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); use combination cautiously with dose adjustment if needed; counsel patient on warning signs.
